# M3.2 — Chat Completion Gateway and Streaming Playground

**Milestone**: M3 — Direct model calls, credentials, history & usage  
**Labels**: `milestone-task`, `backend`, `frontend`, `gateway`, `streaming`  
**Status**: Completed  

## Description
Deliver an extensible, streaming LLM chat completion gateway and integrate it directly into the developer Playground. Enables real inference queries across local OpenAI-compatible servers (Ollama, vLLM), remote OpenAI-compatible endpoints, Hugging Face Inference Providers (`https://router.huggingface.co/v1`), and Hugging Face Dedicated Endpoints, streaming responses incrementally via Server-Sent Events (SSE).

---

## Acceptance Criteria Checklist

- [x] **1. A user can choose an enabled workspace model and submit a real prompt**:
  - Model dropdown loads enabled models from IndexedDB workspace.
  - Disabled models are clearly distinguished and cannot be selected.
  - Submitting a prompt sends request to `POST /api/gateway/chat/completions`.

- [x] **2. At least one local OpenAI-compatible model and one remote provider integrated**:
  - Local Ollama and vLLM runtimes are supported via `local_openai_compatible` using configured `base_url` (e.g. `http://localhost:11434/v1`).
  - Remote OpenAI-compatible endpoints supported via `remote_openai_compatible` with transient Bearer tokens.

- [x] **3. Hugging Face Inference Providers supported**:
  - Routes requests through the official router endpoint: `https://router.huggingface.co/v1/chat/completions`.
  - Authenticates with user-supplied transient Hugging Face token.
  - Supports optional provider selection headers (`X-HF-Provider`).

- [x] **4. Supported Hugging Face deployed endpoints use their configured endpoint URL**:
  - Dedicated endpoints (`https://<id>.endpoints.huggingface.cloud`) supported via `huggingface_inference_endpoint`.
  - Validates endpoint format and prevents confusion with public Hub repository web pages.

- [x] **5. Responses stream incrementally to the Playground**:
  - Backend uses `StreamingResponse` with `text/event-stream` and `X-Accel-Buffering: no`.
  - Frontend parses chunks via `fetch` and `ReadableStream`, rendering tokens in real-time.

- [x] **6. Cancellation and sanitized error handling work**:
  - Active streaming responses can be stopped via the "Stop" button wired to `AbortController`.
  - Reader locks are cleanly released on cancellation.
  - Errors (HTTP 401, 403, 404, 422, 429, timeouts) emit sanitized messages without raw Python tracebacks or leaked secrets.

- [x] **7. Credentials remain transient and do not enter browser persistence or logs**:
  - Tokens reside exclusively in React component volatile memory for the active tab session.
  - Never written to `localStorage`, `sessionStorage`, `IndexedDB`, or URL parameters.
  - Backend receives credentials as Pydantic `SecretStr` and redacts them from logs and events.
  - Tokens cleared immediately upon browser refresh or by clicking "Clear Session Token".

- [x] **8. Usage metadata is normalized and correctly marks unknown or estimated data**:
  - Captures `prompt_tokens`, `completion_tokens`, and `total_tokens`.
  - Explicit provenance tracking (`provider_reported`, `estimated`, `unavailable`).
  - Calculates cost only when pricing basis is known; leaves unknown pricing as `null` rather than false zero.
  - High-precision latency and time-to-first-token (TTFT) metrics displayed.

- [x] **9. Existing M3.1 outbound URL protections remain in place**:
  - Outbound URLs undergo SSRF validation (`validate_outbound_url`).
  - Cloud metadata addresses (`169.254.169.254`) and metadata hostnames unconditionally blocked.
  - Private networks blocked in production, permitted in development mode.

- [x] **10. Automated tests cover normal, error and cancellation scenarios**:
  - Backend pytest tests in `tests/test_gateway.py` covering OpenAI streaming, HF provider routing, HF endpoint routing, 401 auth failures, timeouts, SSRF blocks, and secret redaction.
  - Frontend Vitest tests in `src/tests/gateway.test.ts` covering multi-event parsing, buffer fragment reassembly, HTTP errors, in-stream errors, and AbortSignal cancellation.

- [x] **11. Existing tests continue to pass**:
  - All 38 existing backend tests continue to pass (46 total passing).
  - All 6 existing frontend tests continue to pass (11 total passing).
  - Frontend production build (`npm run build`) succeeds cleanly with zero errors.

- [x] **12. Documentation reflects actual implementation**:
  - Documented in `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/model-configuration.md`, `docs/security.md`, `docs/data-schema.md`, and `README.md`.
